{"script":"cat > calculate_size.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash

dir="sample_directory"
if [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then
  echo 0
  exit 0
fi

# Sum sizes of regular files in the top-level of the directory (do not recurse)
# Print a single integer (0 if none)
total=$(find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%s\n' | awk '{s+=$1}END{print s+0}')

echo "$total"
EOF

chmod +x calculate_size.sh
"}
